d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find bar: columns with >=3 consecutive rows of distinct nonzero colors, consistent down rows
    bar=None
    for r in range(H-2):
        cols=[c for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=0 and all(g[r+i][c]==g[r][c] for i in (1,2))]
        if cols and all(g[r+i][c]==g[r][cols[0]] and g[r][c]==g[r][cols[0]] for i in (1,2) for c in cols) and len(set(g[r][c] for c in cols))==1:
            pass
    # simpler: find rows where a horizontal run of length>=3 all same color, and 3 such consecutive rows same color
    for r in range(H-2):
        for c in range(W-2):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v and all(g[r+i][c]==v for i in range(3)) and all(g[r][c+j]==v for j in range(3)) and all(g[r+i][c+j]==v for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
                bar=(r,c); break
        if bar: break
    br,bc=bar; barcolor=g[br][bc]
    # read color list: vertical strip above/below bar along column bc
    order=[]; r=br
    while r>=0 and g[r][bc]!=0: order.append(g[r][bc]); r-=1
    order=order[::-1]; r=br+1
    while r<H and g[r][bc]!=0 and g[r][bc] not in order: order.append(g[r][bc]); r+=1
    # find existing shape cells per color
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=0 and v!=barcolor: cells[v].append((i,j))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # bounding box of shape for the first color in order that exists
    anchor=None
    for col in order:
        if cells[col]:
            rs=[p[0] for p in cells[col]]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells[col]]
            anchor=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs)); anchorcol=col; break
    r0,c0,r1,c1=anchor
    hgt=r1-r0+1
    idx=order.index(anchorcol)
    # top row of stack
    top=r0-idx*hgt
    for k,col in enumerate(order):
        if col in cells and col!=anchorcol and cells[col]:
            continue
        tr=top+k*hgt
        for (i,j) in cells[anchorcol]:
            out[tr+(i-r0)][j]=col
    return out
